observations.statement: A sharpening conjecture can be scientifically useful even when a weaker lower bound is already proved, provided the exact exponent, encoding, and resource measure are stated.
observations.support: H020 distinguishes the proved 2^(Omega(n^(1/4))) bound from the unproved 2^(Omega(n)) target.

observations.statement: Bounded-coefficient simulations cannot be silently promoted to unrestricted branch-and-cut simulations; coefficient bit complexity is part of the proof resource.
observations.support: H021-H023 and A059-A064 keep SP* and unrestricted Stabbing Planes separate.

observations.statement: Recursive fan-in-two extension syntax can generate globally supported semantic objects, so syntactic arity and semantic dependence must be tracked separately.
observations.support: H024-H025 and H029 exist because current finite-field lower bounds restrict semantic support or arity-count regimes.

observations.statement: A hypothesis whose truth would destroy another live hypothesis is admissible and often more valuable than another constructive route.
observations.support: H027-H029 are explicit adversarial bridge hypotheses aimed at H009, H017, and H010.

observations.statement: Mutually incompatible hypotheses should coexist until a decisive theorem or counterexample resolves the exact formal statements.
observations.support: H022 conflicts with H023, and H024 conflicts with H025, but none was destroyed by the recorded attacks.
